race.description: 100 Years Of Grafton CWA Mdn Plate
race.comment: NO SOUND (11) resumes from a lengthy break. Failed to handle the heavy going with a battling fifth on debut as fav over 1215m at Coffs Harbour last December. Sharpened with a trial placing, and the nose roll goes on from the good gate. SCRAMBLING (14) returned for his second prep with a slashing second over 1015m when coming from last on the turn at this track. Extra trip in his favour from the low draw. WHO LOVES A HARLEY (3) bounced off the good first-up fourth, with a fighting on-speed second over 1218m at Coffs Harbour. Close to his top and good enough to test some of these. MISS SHOW STOPPER (10) Showtime mare from Orutan on debut for the Matt Dunn stable. Hardly set the world alight at the trials and look for a better performance under race conditions. Worth thought with the blinkers going on.
